We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead high-impact product initiatives across TestAssure’s platform. In this role, you’ll operate as a senior individual contributor who combines strategic product thinking with strong execution leadership. You’ll own complex problem spaces end-to-end—driving product direction, aligning stakeholders, and delivering measurable customer and business outcomes.

This is a great role for someone who thrives in a lean environment, enjoys ambiguous challenges, and can work closely with engineering, services, go-to-market teams, and leadership. In this role, you will also build and shape how the Product team will operate and collaborate at TestAssure.

What You’ll Do

  • Own key product areas from discovery through launch and iteration, with clear success metrics.
  • Translate company strategy into product initiatives, and prioritized work.
  • Lead customer discovery, synthesize feedback, and use data to identify opportunities.
  • Define product requirements and shape solutions in partnership with Engineering and Success.
  • Drive alignment across stakeholders (Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Support, Leadership).
  • Support and improve product foundations (scalable product ops processes and tooling)
  • Partner with GTM teams on positioning, pricing/packaging considerations, launches, and enablement.
  • Ensure product experiences are scalable, intuitive, and measurable—balancing UX, tech constraints, and business needs.
  • Create clear documentation: product briefs, requirements, decision docs, and release notes/announcements
  • Interact with other product team members working together to raise the bar on craft, clarity, and customer-centric decision-making.

What Success Looks Like (First 3-6 months)

  • You own a major product bet or cross-team initiative that produces measurable impact (revenue, adoption, retention, efficiency).
  • Initiatives and delivery cadences are smoother: priorities are crisp, decisions are documented, and outcomes are measurable.
  • Teams trust your product judgment and clarity of direction.
  • You strengthen our product culture through better discovery, experimentation, stakeholder alignment and improved ways of work

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of PM (and/or PO experience), including SaaS/B2B or Enterprise background
  • Proven track record shipping successful products as an individual-contributor in high-ownership, fast-paced environments.
  • Track record of leveraging excellent UX instincts to simplify complex systems into intuitive, user-friendly experiences
  • Strong product craft across discovery, road mapping and prioritization, execution planning, and data-informed decision making, with the ability to structure ambiguous problem spaces into actionable plans
  • Uses AI tools to rapidly prototype and iterate on designs in collaboration with stakeholders
  • Comfortable navigating technical debate and articulating the rationale behind product decisions with engineering, including scoping and technical constraints (no coding required)
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, able to explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • Experience leading change management, influencing team behavior and workflows without formal authority
  • Familiarity with product analytics tools, experimentation, and customer research workflows

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Workforce Management or similar environments
  • Experience in QA tools/workflows or automation platform products
  • Experience in designing and delivering AI/LLM based products
  • Experience supporting pricing/packaging, monetization, or growth initiatives
  • Experience in standing up data/insights foundations contributing to product success
  • Prior experience at a startup or company under ~100 employees

Benefits

Why Join Us

  • High impact role with visibility across the business.
  • Opportunity to shape product strategy and execution in a growing SaaS company.
  • Direct access to customers and company leadership.
  • A collaborative, pragmatic team that values outcomes over process.
  • Low egos, PE-backed, remote team (US and CA), health insurance, 401(k) employee match.
  • Compensation is expected to be in the range of $110,000 to $140,000 USD. Remuneration and title will be based on experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Location: Remote, North America, Eastern Time Zone working hours

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Shift5

Shift5 is the observability platform for onboard operational technology (OT). We’re a rapidly growing scale-up that specializes in cybersecurity, predictive maintenance, and compliance for OT systems across defense, aerospace, and rail. We are a collaborative, passionate, and driven cadre of dynamic, multidisciplinary experts focused on helping our customers’ fleets run smarter and safer by accessing and democratizing the volumes of onboard OT data generated by transportation, freight fleets, defense fleets, and other critical infrastructure. Come join us.

Shift5 is seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager to join our team. In this role, you will serve as the critical operational bridge between Program teams, Engineering, and real-world deployments. This role is execution-oriented and deeply cross-functional, focusing on milestone tracking, resource and capacity planning, tooling optimization (Jira/Confluence), and ensuring seamless delivery across internal products and customer deployments.

This position is based out of our headquarters in Rosslyn, VA, but is open to remote candidates within the U.S. This role also requires up to 30% travel to support customer site integrations and testing.

What You’ll Do

  • Cross-Functional Execution & Delivery: Serve as a key liaison between Program teams and Engineering, translating program priorities, milestones, and functional requirements into clear, actionable tasks and engineering plans across hardware, software, firmware, platform, and systems teams.
  • Program Tracking & Risk Management: Track milestones, cross-team dependencies, risks, and resource constraints. Proactively identify execution conflicts and escalate issues that may impact program commitments.
  • Stakeholder Alignment & Facilitation: Partner with Engineering managers, technical leads, TPMs, and Program leadership to align priorities, sequencing, ownership, and timelines. Facilitate planning sessions, status reviews, and cross-functional working sessions to drive decisions and follow-through.
  • Tooling & Process Optimization: Maintain deep expertise in Jira and Confluence to drive project tracking, workflow optimization, sprint planning, and program visibility. Partner with the broader Operations team to continuously improve planning, reporting, and execution processes across Engineering.
  • Resource & Capacity Planning: Support capacity planning by identifying competing program demands and potential bottlenecks across engineering disciplines.
  • Customer & Field Operations Support: Work onsite as needed alongside technical and customer-facing teams to support product deployment, implementation, adoption, and ongoing operations. Manage and prioritize requests from customers, users, and field teams, balancing responsiveness with engineering capacity.
  • Internal Product & Tooling Improvement: Partner with internal users and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and drive improvements to internal products and tooling through requirements gathering, roadmap input, and structured feedback loops.

What Success Looks Like

  • Seamless Program-to-Engineering Translation: You convert ambiguous program goals and functional requirements into crisp, well-sequenced engineering plans with clear ownership across hardware, software, and firmware teams.
  • Proactive Risk & Capacity Control: You anticipate dependencies, competing demands, and execution bottlenecks early, keeping leadership aligned and ensuring program commitments are met without surprises.
  • Operational Visibility & Rigor: Your mastery of Jira, Confluence, and operational reporting gives leadership and engineering teams real-time clarity into sprint progress, roadmaps, and program health.
  • High-Impact Field & User Alignment: You effectively balance urgent customer, field, and internal user requests against engineering capacity, driving smooth deployments and continuous improvements to internal tooling.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • Experience: 4+ years of experience in engineering operations, technical program coordination, project/program management, or a similar role working directly with engineering teams in a cross-functional technical environment.
  • Program & Execution Management: Strong program management skills, including milestone tracking, dependency management, risk management, prioritization, and cross-team coordination.
  • Technical Translation: Proven ability to decipher functional requirements and customer needs into actionable engineering plans while effectively communicating engineering constraints back to stakeholders.
  • Tooling Proficiency: Advanced proficiency with Jira (including custom workflows, dashboards, and reporting) and Confluence for technical program planning and tracking.
  • Communication & Leadership: Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to drive alignment and execution across teams without direct authority.
  • Adaptability & Customer Empathy: Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating in an environment with ambiguity and changing priorities, paired with demonstrated empathy for users and field teams.

Preferred:

  • Government & Defense Experience: Experience delivering software or hardware in support of U.S. Government-funded programs.
  • Complex Systems Background: Experience working with integrated hardware and software systems within aerospace, defense, or other complex technical environments.
  • Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance or the ability to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $119,000 - $131,000
  • Bonus program and equity in a fast-growing startup
  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families
  • Health Savings Account with annual employer contributions
  • Employer-paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • Uncapped paid time off policy
  • Flexible work & remote work policy
  • Tax-deferred public transit benefits with Metro SmartBenefits (DC/MD/VA)

We are committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that embraces the diversity of our people and represents the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives and ways of solving problems. We strive to attract and retain talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.   

Shift5 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, disability, age, marital status, ancestry, projected veteran status, or any other protected group or class.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

About Gameloft

Here at Gameloft, we create moments of happiness for our players all over the world through exciting gaming experiences. This is our mission, and it has been the same for over 25 years. We are the proud creators of Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat, and over 200 other great games.

There is a game for everyone, and we are now expanding to cross-platform games on PC and consoles, with titles such as Disney Speedstorm and Disney Dreamlight Valley, to provide our players with even more amazing adventures.

With more than 3,000 passionate Gamelofters across the globe, we take great pride in our differences and draw on them to create games just as diverse as we are.

If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to work with a bold and talented group of people, don’t hesitate to join the game!

Job Description

As Lead Product Manager for Asphalt Legends, you will be a key figure behind the game’s financial health and long-term sustainability.

Together with the Game Manager and key stakeholders, you will orchestrate the revenue strategy across the product lifecycle, balancing aggressive growth in engagement and monetization with AAA player experience.

You are not just managing a product; you are scaling a global racing phenomenon.

YOUR CHALLENGES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Vision: Partner with Game Leadership (Game Manager, Design, and Marketing) to define the roadmap for future years, ensuring the game’s vision aligns with aggressive commercial targets.

  • Live Ops Excellence: Drive a high-performance Live Operations strategy focused on two pillars:

    • Data-Driven Growth: Continuous optimization of events and offers to maximize LTV and ARPU.
    • Operational Efficiency: Streamlining workflows and automating processes to reduce production times and costs.

  • Monetization Innovation: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of new monetization systems—from conceptual design to post-launch optimization—while constantly auditing existing systems for untapped potential.

  • Data Leadership: Lead hypothesis-driven development by overseeing A/B testing, deep-dive data analysis, and KPI forecasting models to de-risk major business decisions.

  • Mentorship & Influence: Act as a force multiplier for the product team, mentoring junior PMs and fostering a culture of excellence.

  • Organizational Evangelist: Serve as the primary business voice for Asphalt 9 to internal and external stakeholders, elevating the game’s profile across the entire organization.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Product Management of F2P games (Mobile, PC, or Console).
  • Proven Impact. A track record of significantly moving the needle on monetization and retention for top-tier live titles.
  • Analytical Mastery. Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights. Proficiency in advanced analytics tools is expected.
  • Excellent presentation and documentation skills, with the ability to distill complex strategies into compelling narratives for executive leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in economics, business management, marketing, or related field.
    An MBA or advanced degree is highly valued.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience as Product Manager or similar role in other markets.
  • Design Mindset. Strong grasp of Game Design fundamentals and behavioral economics.
  • Deep passion for, or professional experience with Racing Games.
  • Experience with Cross-Platform games or experience in both mobile and PC/Console.
  • Experience in a role that implied team management duties.

Additional Information

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

  • Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
  • Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
  • Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
  • Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
  • Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

  • Permanent contract, full-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
  • 25 vacation days per year
  • Private medical health insurance
  • Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card
  • Flexible work from home hybrid model
  • Free language courses
  • Birthday day off!
  • 1 month of remote work
  • Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
  • Career-development opportunities.
  • Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
  • … and Thursday afterwork beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes’ top 100 companies to work for! We’re gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you’re a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we’re cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

jobs.title: Project Manager II (Remote - USA)
jobs.jd_full:
Interested in joining a growing company where you will work with talented colleagues, enhance a supportive and energetic culture, and be part of the climate solution? At Energy Solutions, we focus on the big impacts. And we believe that market-based programs can be a powerful force to deliver large-scale energy, carbon, and water-use savings. Since 1995, we’ve harnessed that power to offer proven, performance-based solutions for our utility, government, and institutional customers.

Ready to take the lead on projects that make an impact? We’re looking for a Project Manager II for our energy efficiency team, who can turn plans into action, keep teams moving forward, and deliver high-quality results for clients.

In this role, you’ll coordinate multiple programs and projects, manage schedules and budgets, monitor risks and deliverables, and keep stakeholders informed from kickoff through completion. You’ll collaborate across teams, strengthen client relationships, track program performance, and help ensure projects stay on scope, on schedule, and on budget. You’ll also have opportunities to guide junior team members, improve processes, and use data to make smarter project decisions.

We’re looking for a proactive problem solver who thrives on organization, collaboration, and getting things done. If you’re excited to bring people, priorities, and ideas together to deliver meaningful results, this could be the opportunity for you.

 

This position is a remote opportunity, but applicants must reside in Michigan or willing to relocate.

 

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Coordinate the design, implementation, and ongoing execution of multiple programs or a highly complex programs including marketing coordination, participant outreach, and deliverables management.
  • Ensure programs are delivered to scope, schedule, and budget while maintaining quality standards.
  • Monitor progress from project inception to completion and communicates updates to management and clients.
  • Escalate program challenges and risks to Senior Project Managers, Associate Directors, or Directors as appropriate.
  • Assist in the development and management of program budgets and monitors financial performance.
  • Track spending trends, forecast budget performance, and mitigate financial risks to maintain alignment.
  • Maintain client relationships by communicating program scope, reach, performance, and impacts.
  • Ensures client and participant satisfaction through proactive communication and issue resolution.
  • Assigns project work.
  • Monitors team deliverables and progress and escalating performance gaps to leadership.
  • Ensures effective internal communication among team members and across departments.
  • Ensure compliance with program guidelines, client expectations, and internal standards.
  • Utilizes data analytics and reporting tools to inform program decisions and improve outcomes.

 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree OR a high school diploma with 5 years of relevant work experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of professional work experience in project coordination, project management, consulting, or a related role.
  • Willingness and ability to conduct business travel (less than 5%) as needed to support project delivery.
  • Experience working cross functionally with internal teams, clients, or external partners to gather inputs, track progress, and resolve issues.
  • Strong professional communication skills, including the ability to interact with clients and internal partners and present project updates clearly and confidently.
  • Strong technical writing , with the ability to prepare project documentation, summaries, and stakeholder-facing materials.
  • Working familiarity with energy efficiency technologies, including HVAC, water heating, and related systems, or the ability to learn technical concepts quickly.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, including planning, task tracking, dependency management, and follow through.
  • Ability to coordinate and delegate tasks across larger project teams under guidance, ensuring responsibilities and timelines are clearly communicated.
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) to develop schedules, trackers, reports, and presentations.
  • Ability to work independently with moderate supervision, exercising sound judgment to prioritize tasks and manage complex project requirements.
  • Strong quality control practices, including reviewing deliverables for completeness, accuracy, and alignment with requirements.

 

The salary range for this role is $79,000–$92,000/annually with a target compensation of $79,000 - $87,400/annually based on experience and qualifications.

Compensation is commensurate with experience and includes a generous retirement package. Energy Solutions provides an excellent benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance, other pre-tax contribution plans and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

jobs.title: Creative Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

OLIPOP is seeking a seasoned Creative Program Manager to own and lead large, high-priority cross-functional creative programs, with a focus on Shopper creative across in-store displays, point-of-sale materials, retail signage, and related collateral, alongside packaging and production workstreams. This role ensures creative planning and delivery stay aligned with product launch strategies, retailer requirements, and key milestones, with impact across the Creative function and its partner teams.

Engaged early in new product development and Shopper planning, this role guides creative workflows from kickoff and briefing through concept development, reviews, approvals, production readiness, and final artwork delivery. The Program Manager works with a high degree of autonomy: independently establishing priorities, determining the right approach for new challenges, building and managing timelines, connecting stakeholders and dependencies, and coordinating with owners of broader launch, media, and activation plans to keep creative execution on track.

The ideal candidate brings deep fluency in creative development and Shopper execution, strong operational judgment, and an understanding of how production requirements shape creative timelines. They anticipate constraints, navigate competing priorities, and drive complex programs forward through proactive collaboration and clear accountability. Grounded in OLIPOP’s brand and business strategy and current on retail and CPG industry trends, they serve as a trusted advisor and mentor to colleagues on creative program management best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Program Planning & Management

  • Own end-to-end planning and artwork delivery for large, high-priority Shopper creative programs across display systems, shelf signage, toppers, clings, point-of-sale materials, and retailer-specific collateral, managing multiple concurrent workstreams and aligning design milestones with product launch decisions and Shopper activation schedules.
  • Independently establish priorities and develop and manage project-specific timelines spanning briefs, concept exploration, design iterations, stakeholder reviews, packaging renders, proofing, production lead times, and delivery dependencies.
  • Partner with Shopper project managers and Brand, Innovation, Commercialization, and Production partners to confirm creative scope, retailer requirements, inputs, deliverables, and launch priorities.
  • Coordinate creative requirements and milestones with the teams leading broader Shopper programs, tentpole initiatives, retailer media, and promotions, without owning those channel plans or activations.
  • Maintain accurate plans in Asana, with clear owners, decisions, dependencies, and visibility into progress; proactively anticipate risks and blockers, make sound trade-off decisions with limited oversight, and escalate high-impact decisions to leadership with clear options and recommendations.
  • Apply an understanding of OLIPOP’s company and Creative function strategy to prioritize and sequence programs, ensuring creative delivery advances business and brand objectives.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Reviews

  • Lead creative workflow coordination and artwork handoffs for Shopper programs and other production workstreams, including packaging, trade show assets, and sales materials, directing the day-to-day activities of contributors across Creative and partner teams.
  • Coordinate reviews and approvals with Creative leadership, Shopper, Innovation, Commercialization, and Regulatory/Legal, allowing time for feedback, revisions, and production requirements.
  • Consolidate stakeholder feedback, surface differing perspectives, resolve conflicting direction with decision-makers, and drive alignment toward timely decisions and approvals.
  • Lead kickoffs and working sessions to align stakeholders on objectives, responsibilities, retailer-specific needs, constraints, and next steps.
  • Communicate milestones, risks, decisions, and next steps clearly across Creative, partner teams, and leadership, tailoring the message to each audience.

Creative & Production Collaboration

  • Partner with Creative leads to anticipate concepting and design iteration needs, integrating development milestones with production constraints and artwork delivery deadlines.
  • Partner with Shopper project managers to align on print vendor specifications, production feasibility, output requirements, and lead times, translating technical inputs into clear creative requirements and realistic project timelines.
  • Coordinate packaging render development plans, print proofing, pilot attendance, and production-readiness reviews, keeping approvals and artwork handoffs on track.
  • Apply retailer-specific creative specifications, asset requirements, and approval processes to project plans, coordinating with the teams responsible for retailer execution.
  • Identify root causes of recurring workflow issues and implement scalable improvements to creative workflows, cross-functional coordination, and project delivery, sharing best practices across the Creative function to increase efficiency and consistency.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Serve as a mentor and advisor to colleagues on program management methods, tools, and best practices, coaching less experienced team members on planning, stakeholder communication, and accountability.
  • Help the team identify trends, tools, and solutions that improve team and individual performance, and stay current on retail, Shopper, and CPG industry developments that affect creative delivery.
  • Collaborate with peers and leaders across the organization on initiatives that affect the Creative team, representing creative program needs in cross-functional planning.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of project or program management experience, ideally in CPG, an in-house creative organization, or an agency with significant Shopper and production-focused work, including leading large, high-priority creative programs.
  • Strong knowledge of Shopper creative formats and retail environments, including in-store displays, POS, shelf signage, retail collateral, and custom retailer requirements.
  • Deep understanding of creative development, from briefing and concept exploration through iteration, review, approval, production readiness, and artwork handoff.
  • Experience coordinating creative deliverables for major retailers and adapting workflows to differing specifications, guidelines, and approval requirements.
  • Ability to independently build realistic, adaptable schedules balancing creative development, technical requirements, production lead times, and launch deadlines.
  • Comfort translating input from technical and production partners into clear guidance for Creative, including specifications, file formats, feasibility, and constraints.
  • Strong understanding of Shopper media and promotional workflows, with the ability to anticipate creative requirements and coordinate timelines and dependencies across channel teams.
  • Proficiency in Asana or comparable project management tools; sound judgment on complex, high-impact decisions, strong stakeholder influence, and proactive problem-solving across changing priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring or coaching colleagues and improving team processes; working knowledge of retail and CPG industry trends and how they shape creative and Shopper programs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Shopper creative deliverables are completed on strategy and on schedule, with design milestones aligned to launch decisions, retailer requirements, and activation timelines.
  • Creative project plans reflect the realities of design development and production, with clear owners, dependencies, and timely decisions.
  • Creative, Shopper, and production partners have the specifications, feedback, and approvals needed to execute their respective responsibilities.
  • Packaging renders, proofing, pilot participation, and production-readiness checkpoints are coordinated to protect critical deadlines.
  • Approved, production-ready artwork is delivered accurately and on time across Shopper and other production initiatives.
  • Recurring workflow issues are prevented, and scalable improvements and best practices are adopted across the Creative function.
  • Colleagues rely on this role as a trusted advisor, and less experienced team members grow their program management skills through mentorship.

 

REPORTS TO: Sr. Manager, Creative Operations

COMPENSATION: $125-140K base salary + bonus

HOW WE WORK

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we make the effort to stay close, even across time zones. Sure, we move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth, both personal and collective, comes from listening as much as leading. Because at OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together, staying true to what matters, and building something with lasting impact.

 

WHAT WE VALUE

At OLIPOP, our values aren’t just posters on a wall. They shape how we show up: for each other, for our customers, and for the mission we’re chasing together. 

  • Mission Connectivity: Everything we do ladders up to our shared goal: supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.
  • Indomitable Spirit: When things get messy, we get inventive. We stay curious, adapt quickly, and find the path forward, most likely with a dedicated Slack thread and a beautifully overbuilt deck.
  • Lead at Every Level: Leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about ownership. We speak up, follow through, and lift each other up. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.
  • Courageous Humility: We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know (yet). We give feedback with care, take it with grace, and know that real growth takes both.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Success at OLIPOP doesn’t come from checking boxes; it comes from living our values, staying curious, and finding energy in both the pace and the purpose. We’re building something big, and we’re looking for people who: 

  • Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks
  • Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment
  • Value real human connection and honest collaboration
  • Are fired up by building something new, and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is equally fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to help shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a one-of-a-kind ride.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Observability
jobs.jd_full:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London, New York City, Denver, Lisbon, Seattle, or Austin

About the Role

Millions of websites, applications, APIs, and AI agents run on Cloudflare, and the traffic we handle for them produces a lot of data. Some customers want to debug applications and investigate security events in Cloudflare. Others want that data in a stack they already trust, such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or their own data lake. Many want both.

We’re hiring one Senior Product Manager for each of two areas. You apply once, and we’ll work out together which role fits you best.

Observability Platform brings logs, traces, analytics, alerts, and dashboards together in one place, so customers can see what’s happening and why. Today most observability ends with a notification, and the customer does the rest. We want a platform that understands the problem, takes action where it can, and asks before doing anything risky.

Telemetry Export delivers Cloudflare’s data to the tools customers choose. Logpush handles most of that delivery today, and Workers Observability sends logs and traces over the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP). Customers want OTLP for the rest of Cloudflare’s data, metrics pushed to their own tools, and a way to send us telemetry from workloads that run elsewhere.

Your mission is to make reliability and security something customers rarely have to worry about, with the data they need in Cloudflare or in the tools they already use.

What You’ll Do

  • Talk with customers every day and deeply understand their needs. They include developers building on Cloudflare, security teams who feed our logs into a SIEM, and platform teams who run OpenTelemetry pipelines.
  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for your area, and make hard trade-offs between speed, retention, reliability, and cost.
  • Build on open standards like OpenTelemetry, W3C Trace Context, and SQL so teams can keep using the tools they already have.
  • Own the business, including pricing, packaging, and revenue. Measure progress by adoption and reliability.

In Observability Platform, you’ll also:

  • Bring every Cloudflare product into one observability experience, so customers can follow a problem from one product to the next without switching tools.
  • Move beyond notifications to workflows that investigate, roll back, or fix problems, with guardrails customers control.
  • Give people and their agents the context they need to act safely, including how services connect and depend on each other.
  • Own the experience end to end, from first setup to the middle of an incident or an audit.

In Telemetry Export, you’ll also:

  • Bring Logpush, Workers Logpush, and the OpenTelemetry destinations in Workers Observability together as one product, and keep existing integrations working.
  • Ship metrics export and extend OTLP delivery to more of our datasets. Own the intake path for telemetry from outside Cloudflare; Observability Platform will store and query it.
  • Make delivery something customers can trust, so they can see whether their data arrived, get a useful alert when it didn’t, and know how to recover.
  • Help customers filter and transform data before it’s sent, so they export only what they need.

Who You Are

  • You’ve shipped products people depend on, as a PM, engineer, engineering manager, SRE, or founder, and you can point to what changed because of your work.
  • You move fast and own outcomes. You find the most important problem, get the team behind it, ship, and measure.
  • You are a builder at heart. You love getting to a deep understanding of customer needs, and shipping things that help them accomplish their goals. You are passionate about the Observability industry and want to be on the forefront of innovating what it can turn into.
  • You understand how telemetry systems fail, whether that’s a delivery pipeline under backpressure or a query that scans far more data than it needs, and you can explain the reliability and cost trade-offs to engineers and to customers.
  • AI is already central to how you work. You use it to prototype ideas and dig through data, and you have a view on how agents will produce telemetry and act on it.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • You’ve relied on observability yourself, on call during an outage or in a security investigation, and you know where today’s tools fall short.
  • You’ve run or built on telemetry pipelines such as the OpenTelemetry Collector, Vector, Fluent Bit, or Kafka, or you’ve ingested someone else’s data at scale at a vendor.
  • You notice friction, like a confusing error message or a query that takes too many steps, and you fix it.
  • You’ve priced a usage-based product, and you know what happens when existing customers start paying for something that used to be included.
  • You’re comfortable with enterprise customers, whether you’re talking about compliance with a security team or OTLP with a platform engineer.
  • You write clearly enough to get teams across Cloudflare to agree on a plan, and you can translate between what customers need and what engineering builds.

Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $195,000
  • For San Francisco / Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $179,000 - $224,000
  • For New York City/Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $172,000 - $215,000
  • For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €68,000 to €85,000

Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits
Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Who YOU are:
